notes: Source-code to sector mappings, built from sectors.json plus hand-written EuroSciVoc and Climate-ADAPT rows. (a) Keyword matching is whole-word, lower-cased, accent-folded tokens and phrases, never substrings. (b) CPC codes are compared in compact form (spaces and slashes removed, upper case), and the longest prefix wins. (c) An unmapped OpenAlex subfield, EuroSciVoc term or Climate-ADAPT term contributes no sector, so the record falls to keywords and then 'other'. (d) Keyword-only (no code) sorting is capped at confidence 0.6, and a weak keyword counts 0.25 of a strong hit. (e) Tie-break: the highest score wins; on equal scores the earlier sector in sectors.json wins and the record is flagged 'tie' in sort_reason. (f) OpenAlex subfield rows with strength 'medium' are broad and count as medium-confidence signals; the default is 'strong'. (g) Climate-ADAPT terms are spelled exactly as in the harvested records (checked against scripts/nature/catalogue/climate_adapt_sectors.txt); 'Tourism' and 'Non specific' are left unmapped on purpose, and rows whose sector is 'other' contribute no sector score. (h) Corroboration: 'Biomedical Engineering' and 'Biomaterials' are medium. For every sector (generalised in tuning round TUNE-1), when OpenAlex subfields are the sector's only code signal (no CPC, EuroSciVoc or Climate-ADAPT signal for it) and the record has no strong keyword of that sector, the subfield signal counts x0.5. (i) Weak tie (TUNE-1, refines e): when the tied best score is below 0.4, no sector wins; the record goes to 'other' with sort_reason 'weak-tie'. At 0.4 and above, (e) applies.
